findings.title: UI message switched from i18next `{{n}}` placeholders to MessageFormat `{n}`
findings.body: The account-ui loads this file through i18next with default interpolation (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-29` sets only `escapeValue: false`), so placeholders must be `{{0}}`. The server error params reach it via `t(errorMessage, {...params})` (`js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`). Every sibling key in this file uses `{{n}}` (e.g. `error-user-attribute-required=Please specify '{{0}}'.`). With `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and `{2,choice,...}`, i18next leaves the text untouched. A user who violates a multivalued size limit would see the literal text `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` i18next also has no `choice` syntax. The translations of this key, such as the `{{0}}` forms in the admin-ui pl and es files, now disagree with English. Restore the `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}` form here, and use i18next plural syntax or drop the pluralisation. The `{n,choice,...}` form belongs only in `themes/.../base/*/messages_en.properties`, where the server uses MessageFormat and the args are Longs (`MultiValueValidator.java:137`).

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from `{{n}}` to `{n}` and a MessageFormat `choice`
findings.body: The admin-ui uses i18next (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-17`), whose placeholders are `{{n}}`. This file has about 25 `{{0}}`/`{{1}}` uses elsewhere, and the other locales of this key still use `{{0}} … {{2}}` (e.g. `messages_pl.properties:3137`). Server user-profile errors are translated client-side by `setUserProfileServerError` (`js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`). With the new text the admin sees the raw `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}`/`{2,choice,…}` markup instead of the attribute name and bounds. Revert to the `{{n}}` form, and do the pluralisation with i18next syntax if you want it.

findings.title: Lithuanian file gets an Italian string for totpStep1
findings.body: `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users get Italian text on the account TOTP page, with no error. The same wrong text is in `login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71` (`loginTotpStep1`). Use a Lithuanian translation of the English `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:`, or remove the key so the English fallback applies.

findings.title: Lithuanian `loginTotpStep1` is Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, in a file where the neighbouring keys (`loginTotpStep2`, `loginTotpStep3`) are Lithuanian. Translate it into Lithuanian, or delete the key so the English fallback applies.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file gets Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` is in Traditional characters (the zh_TW wording), while the rest of `messages_zh_CN.properties` is Simplified (e.g. `totpStep2=打开应用扫描二维码输入验证码`). Use the Simplified form, `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`, or delete the key so the English fallback applies.

findings.title: Missing English counterpart crashes with an unchecked exception; per-instance policies; typo
findings.body: (1) If the derived `_en.properties` file does not exist, `verifySafeHtml` throws `RuntimeException` (lines 76-80). `verify()` only declares and wraps `IOException` as `MojoExecutionException` (lines 52-54). `ThemeVerifierMojo.execute()` (line 51) therefore fails with a raw stack trace instead of a clean Mojo error naming the file. Throwing `MojoExecutionException`, or skipping the HTML check when there is no English source, would be clearer. (2) `POLICY_SOME_HTML`, `POLICY_NO_HTML` and `HTML_TAGS` (lines 58-63, 139) are instance fields, so a new `HtmlPolicyBuilder` and `Pattern` are built for each of the ~100+ message files. They are immutable and could be `private static final`. (3) The method name `santizeAnchors` is a typo for `sanitizeAnchors`. (4) The English path is derived by `replaceAll` over the whole absolute path (lines 74-75), so a checkout path containing `resources-community` would be rewritten too. Applying the replacement to the file's own path segments would be safer.

contracts.action: Verifier derives the English counterpart path and reads it for every checked message file
contracts.equivalent_path: Existing verifyNoDuplicateKeys read only the file itself (VerifyMessageProperties.java:49-50); ThemeVerifierMojo.execute passes every messages_*.properties under project resource dirs.
contracts.before_after: Before, only the duplicate-key check ran. Now each file is also parsed as a PropertyResourceBundle, and its `_en` sibling is loaded (resources-community mapped to resources). For themes and js, the English file exists in each checked directory (themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/{admin,account,login,email}/messages/messages_en.properties; js maven-resources). A locale with no English sibling would throw RuntimeException.
contracts.visible_effect: Build-time only: the plugin fails the build with 'Validation errors: [...]' for illegal HTML or changed anchors. It does not change runtime behaviour.
contracts.failure_mode: A missing English file or an unreadable file throws an unchecked RuntimeException, so the build fails with a stack trace instead of a message list. This is reported as a consider finding.

contracts.action: Changed error-invalid-multivalued-size text in JS-app English bundles from `{{n}}` to `{n}` plus a MessageFormat choice
contracts.equivalent_path: Other keys in the same files (error-user-attribute-required, error-invalid-length-too-short) use `{{n}}`; setUserProfileServerError feeds the server errorMessage and params to i18next t().
contracts.before_after: Before, `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` were interpolated by i18next with the server-supplied params. Now `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}`/`{2,choice,...}` are not i18next syntax and render literally.
contracts.visible_effect: Users and admins who break a multivalued min/max constraint see raw placeholder markup in the field error.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent. Nothing is logged, and the message is merely unreadable.

contracts.action: Server-side themes base messages_en for login/admin: error-invalid-multivalued-size now uses `{2,choice,...}`
contracts.equivalent_path: The same key in the other community translations still has `value(s)`; MultiValueValidator passes min and max as Long args, which ChoiceFormat needs as numbers.
contracts.before_after: Before: `value(s)`. Now: pluralised via choice with the `{2}` argument, which is a Long, so MessageFormat can format it.
contracts.visible_effect: The English server-rendered message now reads 'value' or 'values' correctly.
contracts.failure_mode: If the arg were a String, ChoiceFormat would throw. It is a Long here, so no failure.

summary: The new verifier is sound, but the message-file fixes it prompted introduced regressions. In both JS-app English bundles (account-ui and admin-ui), `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `{{n}}` to `{n}` plus a MessageFormat `choice`. i18next renders that as literal text in the UI, and the other locales still use `{{n}}`. Three translation edits put the wrong language in a locale file: Italian in `messages_lt` (account `totpStep1` and login `loginTotpStep1`), and Traditional Chinese in account `messages_zh_CN`. Smaller points: the tests only assert that errors are reported and never that valid input passes, and a missing English counterpart file throws an unchecked `RuntimeException`. I only read the code and ran nothing.
